concept: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B on MTPLX with grafted Qwen3.8 draft head
summary: Two kernels written for the pack: a one-step Prism Hadamard rotation (same bits as the four operations it replaces) and a ternary decode matmul.

facts.text: Two kernels written for the pack: a one-step Prism Hadamard rotation (same bits as the four operations it replaces) and a ternary decode matmul.
On every load the kernels are tested on that Mac's GPU against stock ops; a failing kernel is disabled until restart and `/health` reports it.
2.12.0 added the pack (#515); the loader is named `prism_hadamard_qwen35`.
The 16 GB planner used to refuse Bonsai because it could not also fund a warm RAM cache; it now admits it with an 8,192-token window, and a 16K prompt peaks at 12.11 GiB, over the 12.0 GiB budget.
`xhigh` reasoning spent 577 s and 21,848 reasoning tokens on a coding task without answering, where `medium` finished.
Kernel speed on M1 to M4 (only the M5 Max has measured speed).
The Bonsai head accepts 75 percent of drafts, and depth 3 was 14 percent slower than depth 1 over a 3,000-token answer, so depth 1 is the default.
Bonsai uses the compiled verifier, which matched eager in all 613 rounds checked.
The pack is 8.85 GB: 8.60 GB of Prism ML's language model and vision tower unchanged, plus 0.24 GB of draft head.
Both kernels run on every Mac from M1 to M5, and only the M5 Max has measured speed.
The kernels also make prompt reading 7 to 8 percent faster.
Reasoning efforts are `medium` (default) and `xhigh`; Prism ML states `low` is unsupported.
Memory classes: 16 GB uses 12.0 GiB budget and an 8,192-token window; 18 GB 13.5 GiB and 20,480 tokens (36,864 with 8-bit KV); 24 GB 18.0 GiB and 94,208 tokens (167,936 with 8-bit KV).
With the draft head under the 16 GB budget, a 7,006-token prompt and 1,024-token answer peaked at 11.54 GiB GPU and 12.79 GiB process memory with no swap growth.
The peak sits about 3.1 GiB above weights and KV cache, which is what the planner sets aside.
Bonsai 2's accuracy measurement is published, so `mtplx inspect` shows it as verified.
An app menu fix raised Bonsai decode from 45.5 and 46.9 to 48.5 tok/s with the menu open.
